comment: Per-shot allowances against the approved reference. A shot not listed must match exactly in the local acceptance run (exact mode) and within the default 0.5% bad blocks in CI (structural mode). Add an entry only with a reason; never recapture the reference.

page-terms--desktop.png.reason: kramdown typographic apostrophes (don’t) as published by the Jekyll site; the mockup used straight quotes. Owner-reversible: typographic() in src/content/content.ts

page-terms--mobile.png.reason: same: typographic apostrophes | CI (structural mode): text-dense shot re-wrapped by the GitHub runner's fonts; measured 0.873% bad blocks on the first CI run, limit set per shot at ~2-2.5x. tests/visual-structural.test.mjs proves blank/erased/inverted/shifted versions of this shot are still rejected under it (blank pages score 10-35%).

home-posts--mobile.png.reason: Body-region comparison (#74/#76): the reference body starts at a fractional offset (97.78px below the old header), ours at a whole pixel (125px), so the long, text-heavy home page rasterises its rows one pixel apart (the view-toggle chips sit 1px lower, the images do not move). Measured 5.58% of blocks; limit 9%. tests/visual-structural.test.mjs proves blank, erased, inverted and shifted versions of this shot are still rejected under it.

contentDependent.reason: These shots render lists built from all articles, tags, series and curated items (home, tag and series pages, and the search / appearance panels opened over the home page). They cannot match a frozen reference once content has been added. Article pages, themes, Contact, Terms and 404 do not depend on other content and stay mandatory.

bodyOnly.reason: The header (masthead, Meet Adi, Search, Appearance) and footer (Follow Adi, grouped links) were redesigned on purpose in #74/#76 against the approved Lovable design (project a72cd5b7, rev 38e6990), but the frozen reference screenshots still show the previous chrome. Until the reference is re-captured from that design, every shot is compared on its <main> region only, using the <main> bounds in docs/redesign/visual-reference-body.json. The header and footer are verified by tests/e2e/header-footer.test.mjs.

skip.ui-search-open--desktop.png: the search dialog / Appearance panel is positioned against the redesigned header, so a body-only crop cannot isolate it; covered by tests/e2e/reading-controls.test.mjs, search.test.mjs and header-footer.test.mjs
